_comment: Shared vectors for the terms of the glass material an app can state per mode.
Read by coui_core (CoreSurfaceTuning.applyTo and the token / bevel collapse), coui_flutter
(applySurfaceStyle for a light and a dark base theme, and what the theme hands out for each)
and coui_web (the stylesheet's light rule, its dark restatements, and the numbers the
per-element runtime is told), so a rule that changes on one platform fails the others.
preset: what the shipped liquidGlass states before any tuning - one saturation and one
light angle for both modes, and the default refraction law.
tuning: the fields of CoreSurfaceTuning the case states; absent fields are not stated.
saturation / lightAngle: what a surface draws with in each mode afterwards - the chroma
multiplier of the backdrop pass, and the degrees clockwise from the top the edge light
comes from. refractionModel: the law the rim bends by.
A single statement (surfaceSaturation, lightAngle) is about both modes and replaces any dark
statement the preset has; a dark statement (…InDarkMode) alone leaves light as the preset
has it; stating both gives light the first and dark the second.
